author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage meets a pair of Walt Disney Imagineering’s BDX Droids on the set of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, made possible by the latest advancements in robotics married with Star Wars’ pedigree of character-driven design. 

Note: This video is not sponsored. 
Adam Savage Behind the Scenes of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ijk4XMe7n_c
How ILM Films Star Wars Motion Control Spaceships! https://youtu.be/74mnpvN4ysk
Inside the Star Wars Art Department! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B87XJDPxytk
Adam Savage's Animatronic Grogu Build Project! https://youtu.be/KGhqvLLQFzY

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
Additional media courtesy Disney/Lucasfilm
